facts.business: Bajaj Auto Limited manufactures and sells two-wheelers and three-wheelers (including electric vehicles), provides financing through its captive subsidiary Bajaj Auto Credit, and has acquired controlling stake in KTM AG, a European sports motorcycle manufacturer.

capacity_or_capex.item: Bajaj Auto Technology Limited paid-up equity share capital
Bajaj Auto Credit Limited issued and subscribed share capital
Bajaj Auto (Thailand) Limited issued and subscribed share capital
Bajaj Auto Spain S.L.U. issued and subscribed share capital
Equity and debt fund infusion for KTM restructuring via BAIH BV

auditor.name: Makarand M. Joshi & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Post-facto approval of members obtained for material related party transactions undertaken through BAIH BV as part of KTM AG restructuring; approved by members with 98.37% majority on 16 August 2025.

key_risks: Restrictions on heavy rare-earth magnet exports from China affecting EV motor supply
KTM AG acute liquidity challenges and restructuring under Austrian laws
Workplace safety hazards mitigated via Zero-Access guarding, Safety Light Curtains, Biometric Access Control, AMRs, AI-powered cameras, robotic safety systems
facts.related_party_note: Material related party transactions undertaken through wholly owned subsidiary BAIH BV as part of restructuring of KTM AG and its two subsidiaries; post-facto approval obtained from members (excluding related parties) via postal ballot on 16 August 2025 with 98.37% majority; adequate disclosures made to stock exchanges at every stage as required under Listing Regulations.
